sourceIntendedSequence: Capture independent originals before asynchronous callbacks; reject a nonempty caller-owned store before candidate preparation.
Run actual context-v6 candidate preparation, retain initial wire/checkpoint packet, then call real cryptographic payment preflight.
Stop before DB write and require separately retained independent pins; DATA equality is not durable-retention proof.
Consume one commit attempt, call actual V6 atomic method, require original PREPARED revision 1 and exact readback.
Any throw after entering atomic store method remains COMMIT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; retain volatile originals and never automatically retry or replace.
ownerPremisesAndLimits: Default-off source owner is deliberately absent from main until a separately scoped exact-source runtime qualification.
Caller supplies a genuine already-open V6 store from the real factory and owns exclusive lifetime, close, quarantine and recovery.
Prototype equality alone is not hostile-code provenance; wrong profiles may refuse without granting a new signing attempt.
Borrowed wallet/read/material capabilities and unchanged runtime/dependency intrinsics remain trust premises.
Callbacks must not depend on the public preparation Promise; no indirect-cycle sandbox, hard cancellation or whole-operation deadline is proved.
Imported SDK/native-store transitive startup graph is not resolved, imported or executed by this syntax check.
Successful future local readback would not by itself prove crash safety, remote dispatch, inclusion, service delivery or pilot readiness.
Independent pins must be retained outside the DB by their caller before commit; no code claim proves the caller did so.
